"rationale": "The spec window forces A of about 8-10, because f3db >= 25 MHz and GBW >= 240 MHz together cap the gain. A linear resistor (R to the low-impedance vin) sets the gain robustly. That resistor also pins vout_dc near 0.75 V and allows rail-to-rail swing. The NMOS and PMOS gates both sit on vin, so gm adds and gm/I is about 28. That gives gm of about 1.2 mS from about 45 uA. Power is 1.8*(45+Iref) <= 115 uW. The ibias port is terminated by a diode."}

PARAMS = {
    "I":   (45e-6, 25e-6, 60e-6),   # inverter branch current at vin=0.75
    "Ln":  (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),        # NMOS input length
    "Lp":  (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),        # PMOS input length
    "A_t": (9.6, 8.5, 11.0),        # target |gain| (sets R)
    "Lb":  (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),         # ibias termination diode length
}

def _solve_w(lut, dev, L, vgs, vds, I):
    W = 5.0
    for _ in range(6):
        o = lut.op(dev, W, L, vgs, vds)
        W = min(max(W * I / max(o["Id"], 1e-12), 0.42), 4000.0)
    return W, lut.op(dev, W, L, vgs, vds)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    I, Ln, Lp, A_t = p["I"], p["Ln"], p["Lp"], p["A_t"]
    vout0 = vin  # R to vin carries ~0 DC current when In = Ip

    # Size both input devices so each carries I with its gate at vin.
    Wn, on = _solve_w(lut, "n", Ln, vin, vout0, I)
    Wp, op_ = _solve_w(lut, "p", Lp, vdd - vin, vdd - vout0, I)
    gm = on["gm"] + op_["gm"]
    G = on["gds"] + op_["gds"]

    # Parasitic output capacitance estimate (cdd + cgd) from the size() model.
    dn = lut.size("n", max(on["gm_id"], 3), Ln, I, vds=vout0)
    dp = lut.size("p", max(op_["gm_id"], 3), Lp, I, vds=vdd - vout0)
    cpar = dn.cdd + dp.cdd + dn.cgd + dp.cgd
    ctot = cl + cpar

    # A = (gm - 1/R) / (1/R + G)  ->  R = (A + 1) / (gm - A*G)
    den = max(gm - A_t * G, 0.2 * gm)
    R = (A_t + 1.0) / den
    Rout = 1.0 / (1.0 / R + G)
    A = (gm - 1.0 / R) * Rout
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rout * ctot)
    gbw = A * f3db

    # Terminate the ibias port with a diode-connected NMOS (gives IREF a DC path).
    mb = lut.size("n", 10, p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.7)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.M("MP", "vout", "vin", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.R("RL", "vout", "vin", R)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)

    power = vdd * (I + iref)
    vdsat = max(on.get("vdsat", 0.1), op_.get("vdsat", 0.1))
    swing = vdd - 2 * max(vdsat, 0.1) - 0.05
    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout0,
        "swing": swing,
    }
